title: post tasks create task with priority and duedate
description: Verify that creating a task via POST /tasks with valid priority and due_date fields returns 201 with the task including the specified priority and due_date, and that retrieving the task via GET /tasks/{task_id} returns matching values.

title: post tasks validation errors for invalid priority and duedate
description: Verify that POST /tasks returns 422 validation errors when priority is invalid or null, or when due_date is malformed.

title: put tasks update task priority and duedate
description: Verify that PUT /tasks/{task_id} can update priority and due_date fields correctly, including clearing due_date by setting it to null, and that setting priority to null returns a 422 validation error.

title: get tasks filter and sort by priority completed overdue
description: Verify that GET /tasks supports filtering by priority, completed, overdue, and sorting by priority or due_date, returning correct filtered and ordered task lists, and returns 422 for invalid filter or sort values.

title: patch tasks complete marks task completed preserving priority and duedate
description: Verify that PATCH /tasks/{task_id}/complete marks the task as completed, returns the updated task including priority and due_date fields, and is idempotent.

title: delete tasks removes task or returns 404 if not found
description: Verify that DELETE /tasks/{task_id} deletes the task and returns 204, and returns 404 with appropriate message if the task does not exist.

title: get root renders html with tasks priority duedate and visual states
description: Verify that GET / renders an HTML page listing tasks with their priority, due_date, and visual indicators for overdue and completed tasks, and that filters and sorting can be applied via query string with controls reflecting the state.

title: post ui tasks creates task from form and redirects
description: Verify that POST /ui/tasks creates a task from form data including priority and due_date (empty due_date saved as null), returns 303 redirect to /, and that the created task appears on the main page with correct fields.

title: post ui tasks complete and delete redirect even if task not found
description: Verify that POST /ui/tasks/{task_id}/complete and POST /ui/tasks/{task_id}/delete always return 303 redirect to / even if the task id does not exist, without error.

title: database migration preserves existing tasks and seeds new tasks
description: Verify that starting the application with an existing database migrates without error preserving existing tasks with default priority media and due_date null, that seeding on a fresh database inserts sample tasks covering all priority levels and due_date scenarios, and that repeated starts do not duplicate seed data.
